items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Buddy 15 and me and Louie and Chris Kelly and Sam Morgan all of them in front of them.

ctx.x: Does it have a name now? Did they put— Well, ain't nobody playing it now.

I wrote it for Sam. I don't know if he's gonna use it or not. Sam, you know, up there, I wrote it for him. I wish somebody could play it, but you gotta have a good clannery case, because it's got breaks all the way through. Even at the end of it, the clannery makes the end of it, and then we hit the last note.

It's a pretty nice piece. Did any of the tunes have any special names? Well, we call that number one. Yeah, but I mean like the Tiger Rag, did it have another name? Oh, Tiger Rag, that's all. We called it. Did it have any words? That's one thing.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Well, in my time, there was Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly... All them used to play out there.

ctx.x: And what's your name, Paul? Paul Crawford. Dick Allen is my name. So, we got everybody's name here. All right. Now, I guess I wanted to talk to you about trumpet playing, particularly in the old days. Who were some of the outstanding trumpet players you heard when you were young?

Well, in my time, there was Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, Ricard, Louis Armstrong, King Oliver and them. Of course, King Oliver and them were those brothers. King Oliver and Louis Criddy Kepert and them kind of fellas. Another fella by the name of Shatz.
He was older than you or your age?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: I believe I seen a little something Of Sam Morgan Not much

ctx.x: But I didn't stay with him for maybe a week, because Jack Kerry would come out there, and everybody was talking about Jack Kerry, you know. So I said, I believe I joined Jack Kerry. And I joined Jack Kerry. And I joined Jack Kerry. And I went on up. He had a big name. He had a big name. And after that, the boy, let me tell you this, you see. You see, everybody, leader of a band was a trumpet player. Keith Rennie, Buddy Patee, Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, all of them were trumpet players. That's all your bunch? Now…
